messages.subject: DSMextra has been updated
parts:
Hello,

Just as an FYI for people who have been trying to install the `DSMextra` package. The dependency for `rgdal` has been removed, and it should now install without an error message. Thank you to Phil Bouchet for updating the package!

Please follow the installation instructions on the Github page.
https://github.com/densitymodelling/dsmextra

Regards,
Leonard
